meta.description: Designs and analyzes stable-isotope-resolved metabolomics (SIRM / isotope tracing / fluxomics) experiments that measure metabolic ACTIVITY via 13C/15N/2H tracers, distinct from steady-state pool profiling. Covers tracer choice, isotopologue vs isotopomer, mass-isotopomer distributions (MID), fractional enrichment, the mandatory natural-abundance + tracer-purity correction (IsoCor, AccuCor), and the metabolic/isotopic steady-state vs non-stationary (INST-MFA) distinction.

scientific_integrity.detail: All 7 outputs use synthetic or independently-sourced real (accucor extdata) numeric inputs; no fabricated DOI/PMID, trial results, sample sizes, or p-values in any output.

practice_boundaries.detail: No diagnostic/prescriptive claims in any output; bench-research metabolomics framing throughout, including Input 4's cancer-cell-line tracer question.

methodological_ground.detail: The pre-fix M3-adjacent gap (steady-state check licensing flux inference on a still-decelerating series) is resolved and re-verified by direct execution (Input 3: reached_plateau now False on the same series that returned True pre-fix). Input 7 finds a smaller documentation gap (no guidance for <4-timepoint series) that does not itself cause a wrong conclusion -- filed as P2, does not meet the M3 FAIL bar.

code_usability.detail: All executed code (Inputs 1, 2, 3, 5, 7) ran without syntax errors, missing dependencies, or infinite loops, using the real installed isocor 2.2.4 / accucor 0.3.1.9000 packages; Input 2's corrected output matched accucor's own shipped ground-truth reference to 2.775558e-17, and the fixed output_base pattern was confirmed to leave the package's read-only extdata/ folder byte-identical before and after (md5 unchanged, file count unchanged).

functional_suitability.note: All documented use cases (isocor low-res correction, accucor high-res correction, MID/enrichment math, steady-state check, tracer decision tree) covered and run-verified; the pre-fix 1-point dock for the steady-state check's incomplete robustness is restored -- the multi-interval fix is confirmed correct on both the original failing series and two new adversarial series (Input 7).

reliability.note: Common Errors table's causes are accurate; the pre-fix 1-point dock for the half-defined-resolution error text is restored -- the table now quotes the real isocor 2.2.4 text verbatim, confirmed by exact string match against the live exception (Input 5).

performance_context.note: SKILL.md ~198 lines after the redundancy pass, usage-guide kept separate and now points to SKILL.md for install commands instead of duplicating them; correct progressive disclosure maintained.

agent_usability.note: Consistent terminology and runnable code patterns throughout; docked 1 point (not the pre-fix 2) because the fixed steady-state snippet still doesn't tell the agent what to report when fewer than 4 timepoints are available (Input 7).

human_usability.note: Unchanged from pre-fix: Category-3 scene override applied to Forgiveness (strict input validation is correct design here); docked 1 point because isocor/accucor raise plain, non-Skill-specific ValueErrors rather than structured recovery codes -- not in scope of this fix round.

maintainability.note: Clean 3-file separation maintained after the redundancy pass, which removed duplication without breaking modularity; docked 1 point because only one worked example ships and no additional test fixtures were added by the fix.

recommendations.title: Fixed plateau check gives no guidance for <4-timepoint experiments
recommendations.problem: len(deltas) >= 3 (i.e. at least 4 timepoints) is required before the fixed rule can ever return True; SKILL.md never states this minimum in prose, so an agent following the snippet literally reports a 2-3-timepoint series as 'not at steady state' rather than 'insufficient timepoints to assess.'
recommendations.root_cause: The P1 fix corrected the false-positive case (last-pair-only) but did not add a caveat for the now-more-conservative rule's own minimum-data requirement.
recommendations.fix: Add one sentence near the fixed snippet: 'requires at least 4 timepoints (3 consecutive deltas); with fewer, report insufficient timepoints to assess steady state rather than not yet at steady state.'
